scope: Released-file Q5_1 file-exact HF qualification reference and CPU/Radeon consumer results; this does not approve original-weight quantization quality or long-context behavior.

model.reference_weights: The GGUF's own tensors, spec-decoded by tests/spec_decode.py; 311 tensors, 113 F32 and 198 Q5_1, with tied output verified.

commands.reference_generation: python -X utf8 tools/gen_baseline.py file-exact --repo Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B --revision c1899de289a04d12100db370d81485cdf75e47ca --weights-gguf Qwen3-0.6B-Q5_1.gguf --output-dir tests/data/q5-1-file-exact --threads 2
commands.cpu_consumer: python -X utf8 tests/baseline.py --file-exact tests/data/q5-1-file-exact --model Qwen3-0.6B-Q5_1.gguf --exe build-quant-stack/Release/llmx.exe --device cpu
commands.radeon_consumer: python -X utf8 tests/baseline.py --file-exact tests/data/q5-1-file-exact --model Qwen3-0.6B-Q5_1.gguf --exe build-quant-stack/Release/llmx.exe --device vulkan:0

results.contract: For both devices: six prompt rankings, top-1 6/6; top-5 set overlap at least 5 of 5 on all six prompts; identical top-5 order on all six prompts. The consumer requests top 10 but checks only top-1, the top-5 set bound, and exact order of the first five. Eight NLL checks (continuous plus three windows, batched and per-token).

limits: These are file-exact results: HF reference weights are the released GGUF's decoded weights, so they measure runtime agreement on this file rather than its quantization loss against original F32 weights.
Long-context qualification remains open; the recorded windows are short (64-token context with 2 or 4 chunks, and 123-token context with 2 chunks).
No Q5_1 budgets or original-weight quality approval are changed by this record.
